name: finish_cloud_audio_off
description: Cloud audio off (private_cloud_sync_enabled false): Listen takes the live lane, so no batch admission and no fast finish run. Recording A closes at 60 s with its live transcript, and Finish is tapped at 70 s. Finish must still finish A and answer with it (the #26296 shape: the derived row has no audio pieces), with no STT call.

budget.note: Measured 2026-11-26 (178 reads, 54 writes, 1 delete(s), 5 no-op, 0 STT, 7 LLM; caps about +10%). noop_writes=5 is the current count, not a target: every one is database/conversations_v3_leases.py:72 renew (service.reconcile run_blocking renew) rewriting the lease until at the instant it was claimed. The lab clock does not move inside one event; production's does, so this is a lab-clock repeat, reported in the PR.
